=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:3126-3134 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the tick's lease-run cache is empty, the lazy fill in `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci` (`_mt_inflight_review_branches` + `_mt_lease_runs_seed`) runs a full active-run listing pass: 10 `actions/runs?status=...&per_page=100` reads plus possible `MERGE_TRAIN_RUNS_LISTING_SHIFT_RETRY_SLEEP` (2s) sleeps. It runs on every free-lease tick that reaches the final-CI dispatch path, even when no release gate is active, and it repeats on every tick during a gate because the cache is reset per tick (lines 2143-2146).
  WHY: Merges outside a gate now pay about 10 extra REST reads and added latency, where before there were none. Docs-only and sync-quick dispatches also pay for a listing they never use. This violates the issue's acceptance criteria "no added API call per tick outside the retry check's existing reads" and "Reuse a read the tick already makes". All reviewers rated it MAJOR. The minimax reviewer notes that an earlier reviewer had called it a documented trade-off (NIT).
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:207 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment still says the gate-cancel retry cap is "PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_CANCEL_RETRY_MAX times per main tip". The same stale per-tip wording is at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py:837 ("capped per tip"). But `promote_cycle_retry_check` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh) now counts every `[cycle-retry]` run from the last 24 hours on any main tip, `runner_wait_long` retries included.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the comments contradict the cap the code implements. An operator would expect the count to restart when main moves, and would be surprised by a `cap_reached` refusal after one gate cancel on a new tip. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2152-2153 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment describes the retry cap as "times per main tip", but scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh now counts every `[cycle-retry]` run from the last 24 hours on any main tip.
  WHY: The comment misleads operators about the cap semantics. All three reviewers rated it NIT. The sonnet and glm reviewers cite this file at line 2153 as part of their promote-main-to-stable.yml:207 finding.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1940-1946 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The gate-cancel retry cap in `promote_cycle_retry_check` counts every `[cycle-retry]` run from the last 24 hours without filtering by main tip, and it also counts retries triggered by `runner_wait_long`.
  WHY: After three such retries on other tips or for `runner_wait_long`, a gate-cancel retry for the current tip is refused with `cap_reached`. The issue requires a per-tip cap and says the `runner_wait_long` path stays uncapped. Rated MAJOR. The other reviewers treat this behaviour as intended and flag only the stale comments, as NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If the plan finds that change 2 cannot be made without a new per-tick API call or without slowing merges outside a gate, implement change 1 alone and say so in the PR body with the evidence." Acceptance: "No new workflow or job, and no added API call per tick outside the retry check's existing reads."
  expected_change_site: The PR description. Alternatively, scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci`: remove the lazy `_mt_inflight_review_branches`/`_mt_lease_runs_seed` fill at lines 3126-3134 and keep the cache-only hold that logs runs_unread.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body contains only the pre-push test gate report and the Acceptance table (every target marked "not run"). It does not invoke the item 3 escape clause and does not mention the new ~10-read listing pass on free-lease ticks. The trade-off is documented only in the README `RELEASE_GATE_FINAL_CI_HOLD_MAX_MINUTES` row, agents.d/10266-gate-cancel-retry-final-ci-hold.md, changelog.d/10266-gate-cancel-retry-final-ci-hold.md, and the AI autofix editor summary (PR comment 7243310503, which planned "ISSUE 001 trade-off, for the PR body"). The glm reviewer says reverting the fill is not requested, because it closes the hold gap in the 2026-11-28 incident, and the minimal fix is one PR-description paragraph.
- requirement: "Reuse a read the tick already makes" and "No new workflow or job, and no added API call per tick outside the retry check's existing reads."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The last-run diff adds a call to `_mt_inflight_review_branches` when the cache is empty. That helper makes ten `actions/runs` status-listing reads, so this path adds reads on ticks that had not already filled the cache.
- requirement: Issue #10266 Acceptance: "the poller ... retries ... at most PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_CANCEL_RETRY_MAX times per main tip". The README row now says "at most `PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_CANCEL_RETRY_MAX` `[cycle-retry]` runs were created in the last 24 hours on any main tip".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml around line 207, .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml around line 2153, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py around line 837
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `promote_cycle_retry_check` in scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh (lines 1929-1944) now counts every [cycle-retry] run from the last 24h on any main tip. It dropped the per-head_sha filter and turned the cap line's "head=" into a context label only. The YAML comments and the contract-test comment still describe a per-tip cap.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:207 (also .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2153, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py:837) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These comments still say the cap is per tip ("times per main tip" / "capped per tip"). But `promote_cycle_retry_check` now counts every "[cycle-retry]" run from the last 24 hours on any main tip, runner_wait_long retries included. The README, agents.d fragment, changelog and script header were updated; these comments were not.
  WHY: Nothing crashes, but an operator would expect the count to restart when main moves. The script can refuse with PROMOTE_CYCLE_RETRY outcome=cap_reached after a single gate cancel on a new tip.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci lazy-fill block (cache reset lines 2143-2146; listing loop lines 1339-1350) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On free-lease ticks (state ""), every dispatch that reaches "dispatch no_run" first runs a full listing pass: at least 10 Actions API reads plus the memoized repos/<repo> read, with possible 2s shift-retry sleeps. The fill runs before `_pr_ensure_final_ci` picks the docs-only/sync-quick/full form, so docs-only and sync-quick dispatches pay for it without using it. During a gate, every tick repeats the pass.
  WHY: Merges outside a gate get about 10 extra REST reads and added latency per dispatch. The issue forbids "no added API call per tick outside the retry check's existing reads" and requires "Reuse a read the tick already makes". The new test asserts `any("actions/runs?status=" in c for c in h5.calls)`, and h6 shows the listing runs with no gate.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: Item 3 of issue #10266 ("...implement change 1 alone and say so in the PR body with the evidence"). Acceptance: "no added API call per tick outside the retry check's existing reads". Change 2: "Reuse a read the tick already makes (§15)".
  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci` (remove the lazy fill and keep the cache-only runs_unread hold), or the PR description (state the listing pass, its cost and why it was accepted).
  Evidence of absence: The PR description contains only the pre-push test gate report and the Acceptance table. The trade-off appears only in the README row, the agents.d fragment, the changelog fragment and the editor's PR comment.
- (hardening) scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_ready_final_ci, else branch logging "RELEASE_GATE_FINAL_CI_HOLD outcome=runs_unread"
  PROBLEM: With RELEASE_GATE_FINAL_CI_HOLD_MAX_MINUTES=0 the code still logs outcome=runs_unread on every free-lease dispatch, which is misleading while the hold is disabled.
  WHY: The suggested fix is to add the `^0+$` guard to the log or skip the block; about 2 lines. (2 related items: also emit an "outcome=listed" line after the seed so the listing reads show up in log analysis, 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
